data.one_liner: Simple peer-to-peer WebRTC wrapper for Dart and Flutter supporting data and media streams.
data.what_it_does: PeerDart provides a complete peer-to-peer API built on top of WebRTC, mirroring the PeerJS library. It enables data channels and media streaming connections between devices for mobile and web.
use_when: You want to build peer-to-peer data sharing or video/audio calls in Flutter.
You are already familiar with the PeerJS API ecosystem.
avoid_when: You require production-ready stability, as the library is currently in public alpha.
You want a traditional centralized server architecture rather than peer-to-peer.
strengths: Supports both data channels and media streams.
Mirrors the popular PeerJS design and documentation.
Works on both mobile platforms and web browsers.
weaknesses: Still in alpha stage under heavy development with potential bugs and missing functionality.
data.setup_notes: Requires camera and audio permissions for media calls on mobile platforms, and a PeerServer connection.
